subject.title: Feature: Expose OpenRouter usage cost to agent runtime

question: What exact provider-reported usage-cost contract should OpenClaw expose for OpenRouter responses?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the durable API shape, units/source semantics, fallback precedence, and session/runtime exposure are product contract decisions rather than a narrow bug repair.

options.title: Add exact provider-cost metadata
options.body: Expose OpenRouter raw `usage.cost`, source/units, and `cost_details` as a separate additive contract alongside existing estimated USD fields.

options.title: Fold into broader usage API
options.body: Keep this issue open but resolve it through the broader session_status/runtime usage API work so token, exact cost, and model attribution share one contract.

options.title: Defer exact provider billing
options.body: Keep OpenClaw on local estimated costs only and close or deprioritize exact OpenRouter billing visibility as out of product scope.

recommendation.title: Add exact provider-cost metadata
recommendation.body: Expose OpenRouter raw `usage.cost`, source/units, and `cost_details` as a separate additive contract alongside existing estimated USD fields.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the partial OpenRouter cost reconciliation and has the clearest recent history on the provider-cost/runtime boundary.
